errors.description: done_vector_q is a multi-bit value produced in dma_clk and sampled directly in irq_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
done_pulse_q is a one-cycle dma_clk pulse consumed directly in irq_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
done_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample irq_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in irq_event_o.
arb_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector arb_mode_q before decoding in irq_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
dma_rst_n is used as data inside irq_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
cfg_snapshot_q combines dma_clk payload state with irq_clk status state in cfg_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
